# Verification Before Completion

This is a fixture file for testing render-universal-skills.ts.

## Self-verify gate

You MUST run the full gate before declaring done.
You MUST NOT skip tests to save time.
You cannot mark work complete without evidence.

## Gate failures

HARD rule: a red gate means failed — never pass with notes when gate is red.
You must always record exit codes in the evidence field.

## Evidence collection

always gather command outputs, not just assumptions.
